text_block_list.text:
At last, it's time for Fuji Kiseki's Debut 
Race.

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"‘The Umamusume to watch is Fuji Kiseki. 
Standing out even before her debut, rumors 
say trainers were lining up in droves to 
scout her!’"

text_block_list.name: Announcer B
text_block_list.text:
"I see, so your current Trainer is the one 
you personally hand-picked?"

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. I'm very much looking forward to 
seeing how both of them will make their 
debuts!"

Perhaps due to the Fuji Kiseki effect, 
even before the debut, high expectations 
were already being placed on both her and 
her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, shall I cast a very special good 
luck charm on you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's a special charm that'll give you 
courage. Give me your hand, okay?

Extending my right hand as prompted, Fuji 
Kiseki gently takes it in both of hers.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I know you very well. You are brave, you 
are wise, and you are kind."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If you let go, courage will overflow in 
your heart. Look up and find the rainbow.

With those words, her hand slowly pulled 
away.

Feeling something in the palm of my hand, 
I look down—and find a piece of chocolate 
resting there.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
They say chocolate makes your anxiety 
disappear. Think of it as a little bonus 
to my lucky charm.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Did that help ease your nerves a bit?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, I've gotta run soon! See you 
later, Trainer!"
Fuji Kiseki briskly leaves the room.

With my right hand warmed up and the sweet 
chocolate, before I knew it, all my 
tension had melted away.
